colophon.iast: Composed by Poigai Alvar, one of the three Mudhalazhwars ("first Alvars") whose Tiruvantatis open the Iyaṟpā section of the Naalayira Divya Prabandham. No Tamil-script source found yet — English romanization only for now.

aran nAraNam nAmam An vidai puL Urdhi
